protocol.cells: hidden, non-root, continuous (categorical columns excluded: f undefined in the code frame)
protocol.seeding: torch re-seeded per table before the batch and before encode
protocol.admission: pooled mse_f < min(0.98 x const, floor) under both policies

verdict.rule: clue = every admitted dual seed (>=2) beats the admitted ds mean under both policies; strata cell = Holm-significant paired sign test in the same direction under both policies
